headline: Production runs without a restorable backup: 25 of 33 Production tiles have no verified off-host copy.
judgement: Deploys are flowing, so the risk is not delivery but loss. The backup feature exists and reports not-configured: there is no backup key and no off-host target. The only copy of the application state is a manual snapshot of 9 November on the same disk, which a disk failure takes with it; the workspace repository is safe on its git remote. Two owner decisions unblock everything else: the off-host target and the custody of the two keys. Until then every Production deploy adds state that cannot be restored. One deploy credential expires in 9 days and will stop Staging deploys of the project it belongs to.
